title: SIDESTORY: LINGERING ECHOES OPEN
lines: 01 SIDE STORY: LINGERING ECHOES OPEN
DETAILS: Lingering Echoes event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from the event shop.
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
EVENT STAGES DURATION: Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
- [Afterglow Hall] Duration: December 27, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- [Back Alleys] Duration: January 3, 2023, 16:00 (UTC-7) - January 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Spy Base]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Spy Base] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
MAIN REWARDS: ★★★★★: Czerny, Afterglow-Styled Music Room Furniture (Pieces), Sheet Music.
[Composer's Mailbox]
DURATION: December 27, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 17, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Sheet Music by clearing event stages and [Spy Base]. Sheet Music can be used to redeem items from [Composer's Mailbox].
MAIN REWARDS: Czerny's Token, Afterglow-Styled Music Room Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Parts, etc.
During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in Public Affairs. After the event ends, the event stories will be recorded in Public Affairs.
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – DISSONANZEN
DURATION: December 27, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Dissonanzen], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate from this Standard Headhunting:
★★★★★★: Ebenholz
★★★★★: Hibiscus the Purifier / Blue Poison
03 NEW OPERATORS AVAILABLE
DETAILS: The following Operators will be added to the game.
★★★★★★: Ebenholz
★★★★★: Hibiscus the Purifier
★★★★★: Czerny
NOTE:
- Operator Czerny is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Lingering Echoes. Operator Czerny is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Recruit.
- Operator Ebenholz and Hibiscus the Purifier will be permanently added to other Headhuntings in future update.
- Operator Ebenholz, Hibiscus the Purifier, and Czerny will gain more trust in the event stages.
04 ACHIEVEMENT STAR COLLECTION NEW ARRIVALS AT OUTFIT STORE
DURATION: December 27, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: The following new Outfits will be available at the Outfit Store, including:
Achievement Star Collection - Sport For All for Flametail
Achievement Star Collection - Light Gun Adjuster for Aosta
Achievement Star Collection - Trendsetting Player for Kirara
05 NEW FURNITURE SET – AFTERGLOW-STYLED MUSIC ROOM
DETAILS: A brand new set of themed Furniture, Afterglow-Styled Music Room, will be available during the event.
HOW TO OBTAIN:
- Lingering Echoes event rewards and redeem in Composer's Mailbox (Pieces)
- Limited-time sale at the Store (Pieces) from December 27, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) to January 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
06 CHIP PACKS AVAILABLE FOR A LIMITED-TIME
DURATION: December 27, 2022, 10:00 (UTC-7) - January 10, 2023, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
Dissonance Chip Pack
CONTENTS: Caster Chip Pack * 8, Caster Chip * 5, and LMD * 210000.
